Dear MUTANI Team,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the Growth Marketing Internship at MUTANI. As a Junior Digital Marketer with a strong foundation in SEO, GEO, and analytics, I am drawn to your innovative approach to merging gaming culture with contemporary fashion and your mission to build an engaged community.

My experience at Episto, managing on-page SEO and tracking performance with Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs, directly aligns with your focus on understanding marketing effectiveness. Furthermore, my independent project, mirook.com, involved implementing technical SEO, structured data, and social media integration to measurably improve online visibility.

I am eager to apply my analytical mindset and problem-solving skills to contribute to your upcoming October collection launch and help MUTANI reach its growth ambitions. Based in Zwijndrecht, I am well-positioned for collaboration.

Thank you for your consideration.

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear MUTANI Team,

I am writing with great enthusiasm to apply for the Growth Marketing Internship, as advertised. Your vision of translating iconic digital worlds into contemporary fashion, combined with your focus on data-driven growth and community building, deeply resonates with my professional aspirations. I believe my background in digital marketing, coupled with my analytical approach, makes me a strong candidate to support your team ahead of your significant October collection launch.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I regularly engage in activities pertinent to this internship, including managing on-page SEO, crafting keyword-targeted content, and meticulously tracking website performance using tools like Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. This hands-on experience has honed my ability to identify trends, analyze content effectiveness, and present data-backed recommendations for improving organic visibility and search rankings – skills directly applicable to monitoring MUTANI’s Instagram, TikTok, and website performance.

My independent project, mirook.com, further showcases my proactive engagement with growth marketing principles. I personally designed, built, and optimized the site, implementing structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably enhanced its search-health score and overall visibility. This project also involved social media integration, demonstrating my understanding of building an online presence and community engagement.

The prospect of contributing to MUTANI’s ambitious growth journey, particularly through creator outreach and supporting paid marketing campaigns, is particularly exciting. I am a curious and organized individual who enjoys researching trends and testing new ideas to solve marketing challenges. I am confident that I can quickly integrate into your team, bring a strong work ethic, and make a tangible impact on expanding your brand’s reach and fostering an engaged community.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills and drive can benefit MUTANI.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
